service.description: Download and print the e-Aadhaar (PDF) of an existing Aadhaar.
service.depending: Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID, mobile number linked with Aadhaar (for OTP)
service.rules: The e-Aadhaar PDF password is the first 4 letters of the name in capitals and the year of birth (e.g. RAME1990).
